facts.fact: leFaso.net reports that the tax directorate DGI began training more than 400 agents on 4 November 2026 on SYC@D, the integrated cadastre and domains management system.
facts.system: SYC@D (Systeme integre de gestion du cadastre et des domaines)

facts.fact: leFaso.net says SYC@D facilitates the online issuance of allocation certificates, transfer orders and cadastral extracts.
